description: This file defines a PHP class 'smpl_Lead_Sample' that generates an HTML email template for a 'Lead' type, including company information, styling, and placeholders for lead details.

classes.name: smpl_Lead_Sample
classes.description: A class responsible for generating an HTML email template for lead samples, including header, footer, and body content with placeholders and dynamic content.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'Leads', indicating the type of document or template.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns an HTML string for the email body, incorporating localized text, dynamic addresses, and placeholders for lead-related data.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific footer content.
